semantics.parse_rule: Parser preserves all required and compatible extension semantics.
semantics.normalize_rule: Normalization is lossless for semantic meaning.
semantics.serialize_rule: Serialized bytes may differ while semantic graph remains equivalent.
semantics.comparison_rule: Identity, ownership, structure, behavior, semantics, constraints, refs and prose-equivalence rules are explicit.
semantics.byte_rule: Byte-identical equivalence is a separate stricter profile.
semantics.finding_rule: Loss of required semantic information is conformance failure.

invariants.rule: Every Contract Format section and field has explicit machine-readable meaning; consumers never infer semantics from JSON ordering, filenames, indentation, prose style or neighboring fields.
These contracts document and constrain Contract Format semantics but do not replace the repository-root AIGMos_Canonical_Contract_Format_v1.4.0.json bootstrap authority.
